nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: It's time to announce the winners...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Hector and Amanda, you have successfully answered more questions correctly than Howard and $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Congratulations! You've won the Mistletoe Match Game!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Please step forward and claim your prize!
Hector takes the bracelet from the man.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Bye! Thanks for playing! Congratulations again!
The couples turn to one another.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good game, man.
Hector and Howard shake hands while the girls hug.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You two deserve it. Merry Christmas you guys!
Howard and $ZOE leave the store and head for the cafe nearby.
In the store, Hector fastens the bracelet on Amanda's wrist.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, Hector, I absolutely love it! The horn on the unicorn even sparkles!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm glad you like it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We really have been through a lot, haven't we?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes... And I'm looking forward to going through so much more...
Amanda links her hand through Hector's.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: With you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I love you, Manda-Panda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love you too.
Thanks for playing this special holiday segment of `Surviving High School!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for playing this special holiday segment of [b]Surviving High School![/b]

nodes.text: Happy holidays and happy new year!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But since both couples have earned the same amount of points, it's a tie!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Now, after reviewing what I've witnessed...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: It seems that taking a point from Howard and $Zoe in on the last question was a little hasty.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Their answer is close enough and now counts. Which means...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Howard and $ZOE, you have successfully answered more questions correctly than Hector and Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Congratulations! You've won the Mistletoe Match Game!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Please step forward and claim your prize!
Howard takes the bracelet from the man and fastens it on $ZOE's wrist.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, we won!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without you...
They share a kiss.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good game, man.
Hector and Howard shake hands as the girls hug. When they leave, Amanda looks sadly at the floor.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's wrong, Manda-Panda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm beginning to think we don't really belong together...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: First, the bear cape... Now this...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's like you don't know me at all!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, Amanda... It's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know a lot of things about you! Just not the things on those cards...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Like what? Name one thing that I really like.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Er... Lizards?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Lizards? `Lizards?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Lizards? [color=#3b78e2][i]Lizards?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know how I feel about lizard bellies!
Amanda runs off!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, wait! Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Amanda!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Amanda![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Oh no! It seems like Hector and Amanda are going to have a rough holiday season ahead of them!
Try again and see if you can help Hector win Amanda that charm!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I'm sorry to say that's totally incorrect.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You think I'm scared of clothes?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, aren't you afraid of clown pants?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Because they're on `clowns!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because they're on [color=#3b78e2][i]clowns![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm afraid of fractions! All my denominators are uncommon!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That is totally wrong.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I put down fractions.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're more afraid of fractions than losing me?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, you don't go around dividing yourself!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Well, that's not what I would've gone with...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But it's `absolutely correct!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But it's [color=#e23b3b][i]absolutely correct![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Fractions are scary!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... Um...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector... You've used up all your time.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was fractions...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: And we're on to round three!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: And we're on to round three!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: All right... At this point in the game, both couples are neck and neck.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: The final question will determine which one wins the charm bracelet...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: And we're on to round three!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: All right... It seems like Howard and $ZOE have taken an early lead.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But, Hector, pay attention. Answering this question might prove that you actually know your girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: We asked the girls to name the one thing that scares them the most...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what it is that scares $ZOE the most...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But she is a really thoughtful girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, you're so sweet.
$ZOE kisses Howard.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, he hasn't even answered the question yet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm getting there. `Because` $ZOE is so thoughtful, the thing that scares her the most is when all of her loved ones are unhappy.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm getting there. [color=#e23b3b][i]Because[/i][/color] $ZOE is so thoughtful, the thing that scares her the most is when all of her loved ones are unhappy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I put that I'm scared of seeing all of my friends and family upset at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't think I can count that. She specifically said when they're unhappy `at the same time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't think I can count that. She specifically said when they're unhappy [color=#e23b3b][i]at the same time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Come on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Howard. I know in my heart you were right...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: So, Hector, you're up. What is Amanda most scared of?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda is most scared of...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: In Europe.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No...
Amanda turns her card over. It reads 'Rushin New Year'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That was the time I realized you were the one I wanted to be with.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, what was wrong with Europe?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, we made out in Europe because we were both feeling lonely.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The Russian New Year...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just curious, why is that kiss so special?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was the first time I kissed Hector when I knew I wanted to be with him!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The most special kiss in the world!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: During the Crosstown Races!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No...
Amanda turns her card over. It reads 'Rushin New Year'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That was the time I realized you were the one I wanted to be with.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, what was wrong with the Crosstown Races?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was still sad about breaking up with Zach.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... I can't choose...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector... Time's up.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was Russian New Year! That was the one with the most feeling!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Weren't they all important?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Okay, on to round two!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Both of your girlfriends have told me you've been together for a long time.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But let's take a look at the beginning of your relationships...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Where did you two have your first kiss?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At the football game right after you were voted onto the cheerleading squad!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Our `real` first kiss was after our date at the coffee shop.
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard... Our [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] first kiss was after our date at the coffee shop.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh yeah...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Hector, you're up. Where did you and Amanda have your first kiss?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There were a couple of 'first' kisses for us...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There was Europe where we first made out...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There was Russian New Year where we kissed, and we weren't dating, but that was a special 'first'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And then, after I got out of Boot Camp, we had a date and kissed at the Crosstown Races...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I chose the most special one! The kiss I gave you with the most feeling!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I'm afraid she can't clarify further. You'll have to figure out which kiss she wrote on the card.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's $ZOE's favorite dessert!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mine is candy!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector... Looks like $ZOE and Howard pull ahead.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Tiramisu?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Amanda, what did you write?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I wrote 'candy'... Hector, you know anything with caffeine in it makes me super shaky!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's got to be candy.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gummy Mares are her favorite!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Amanda, what did you write?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Candy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector... Time's up. Maybe you'll have better luck with the next question.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was candy...
Happy Holidays! Welcome to a special premium mini-episode of Surviving High School!
You'll be playing as Hector. Can you help him win Amanda a great gift?
Find out now!
It's the day after Christmas, and Hector and Amanda are shopping at the mall...
But not everything is going well with these two...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, I'm sorry you didn't like the Christmas gift I gave you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But it was all the things you said you wanted...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Soft, furry, funny, sunny...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, a `bear fur cape` is soft and furry, but it's definitely `not` funny...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, a [color=#3b78e2][i]bear fur cape[/i][/color] is soft and furry, but it's definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] funny...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Or` sunny!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Or[/i][/color] sunny!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, don't be sad. I'll... I'll make it up to you...
Hector and Amanda enter a store. Hector looks around.
In the jewelry section, a silver bracelet with a single unicorn charm hangs prettily in a case.
Hector steers Amanda towards the jewelry counter.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I was hoping to see your charm bracelets, good sir.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Especially `that` one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Especially [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] one.

nodes.text: Hector points to the bracelet in the case.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Oh, that is delightful! Unfortunately... I can't sell that to you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But you can `win` it if you participate in our Mistletoe Match Game...
nodes.text_bbcode: But you can [color=#e23b3b][i]win[/i][/color] it if you participate in our Mistletoe Match Game...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A Mistletoe Match game?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Yes, we're running it as an after-Christmas promotion.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: If you join now, we can get started, since we already have another couple here to compete with you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes, we'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh, I love matching!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you have to do?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Well, first, you can meet the couple you're up against.
The clerk waves his hand to the other side of the counter where Howard and $ZOE are waiting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hello, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you two doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I participated in this thing last year and thought it would be fun to do it again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: With my `actual` girlfriend this time. I think we have a good shot.
nodes.text_bbcode: With my [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] girlfriend this time. I think we have a good shot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, but can we make this quick? $ZOE and I are kind of looking after my younger sisters...
Howard looks out the window to the toy store where two young girls are holding out a baby to strangers.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Of course, sir. Let's get started.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great! May the best couple win.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Now the rules are simple. I'll have your girlfriend write down the answer to three different challenge questions...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Then we'll tell you the question, and ask you what `her` answer was. The couple who answers the most questions correctly wins the charm bracelet. Ready?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then we'll tell you the question, and ask you what [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] answer was. The couple who answers the most questions correctly wins the charm bracelet. Ready?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep!
The clerk takes the girls aside. Hector watches them scribble hastily on cards.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Shoot! Howard and $ZOE have been together `forever.` They probably know tons about each other.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot! Howard and $ZOE have been together [color=#e23b3b][i]forever.[/i][/color] They probably know tons about each other.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But then again... So do Amanda and I. We can win this... If I can figure out what she's thinking...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: ...And that about does it, girls. Boyfriends, are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Okay, here goes...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: We asked Amanda and $ZOE to name their favorite `dessert`...
nodes.text_bbcode: We asked Amanda and $ZOE to name their favorite [color=#e23b3b][i]dessert[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Howard, what is $ZOE's dessert of choice?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's easy. Cupcakes.
$ZOE holds up a card that reads 'cupcakes'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's right!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: And that's a point for Howard and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Now Hector, what is Amanda's favorite dessert?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... She likes everything sweet? What's the sweetest thing we've ever eaten?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda's favorite dessert is...
